start.name_en: Liudong Distribution Station (Liudong New District) -- part of the Liuzhou City dedicated gas supply pipeline project, expanded under this project
start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '柳东新区' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%9F%B3%E4%B8%9C%E6%96%B0%E5%8C%BA) -- suburb/district boundary centroid. Station name from the wsbs.liuzhou.gov.cn EIA public notice: '输气线路起自柳州市天然气专供管道工程柳东分输站，出站后经福禄屯、凉亭村和底料，穿越057乡道进入柳城县境内'.

end.name_en: Luzhai Distribution Station (Luzhai County) -- newly built under this project
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '鹿寨县' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E9%B9%BF%E5%AF%A8%E5%8E%BF) -- used the county-seat/city-type node (place_rank 16) rather than the wider county administrative boundary centroid, for a tighter anchor. Station name from same EIA notice: '管道出阀室后绕过柳东新区规划区后向东南方向敷设至鹿寨分输站'.

corridor_notes: ~31km branch line running from the Liudong distribution station (Liudong New District) via Fulutun, Liangting Village and Diliao into Liucheng County; the line then routes around the Liudong New District planning area, turning northeast through Dashan Village, Sijiao and Shanchang into Luzhai County; continues northeast via Baihua Village to the Luorong (雒容) valve room; then heads southeast (again routing around the Liudong New District planning area) to the new Luzhai distribution station. Length breakdown matches GEM exactly: 4.3km in Liudong New District + 6.9km in Liucheng County + 19.8km in Luzhai County = 31.0km total. Design capacity 1.1x10^8 Nm3/yr, design pressure 6.3 MPa, diameter DN300; one new station (Luzhai distribution station) and one new valve room (Luorong) built, plus expansion of the Liudong distribution station. Note: the source text references bypassing the Liudong New District planning area twice (once near the start of the route, again near the end just before reaching the Luzhai distribution station) -- reads as a possible drafting quirk/repetition in the original EIA text rather than a real routing detail; flagged, not resolved.
researcher_notes: Best-documented of this batch's four PIDs. The prior pilot pass had already located this exact wsbs.liuzhou.gov.cn EIA public notice with a route description whose per-county length breakdown matches GEM's LengthMergedKm to the decimal. This pass re-fetched the page directly (raw curl, after an earlier WebFetch attempt on a different URL pattern returned ECONNRESET; not AI-summarized) to confirm the verbatim Chinese route text and extract literal station/place names (柳东分输站, 鹿寨分输站, 雒容阀室) for geocoding. Despite additional searching, this remains a SINGLE-SOURCE finding -- no second independent document was found by either pass. Per the project's 2+ independent source rule this would rate medium (not high) confidence on the standard corroboration scale, even though the route/length detail is unusually specific and internally consistent with GEM's own figures.
blockers: Only one independent source (wsbs.liuzhou.gov.cn) found for this segment despite targeted searching in both this pass and the prior pilot pass; does not meet the 2+ independent source corroboration target even though the single source is detailed and highly consistent with GEM's own data.
